title: Observatory
shortDescription: Brass instruments wait beneath a roof the colour of old pennies.
longDescription:
The observatory smells of cold metal and cedar shavings. A brass telescope points toward the roof slit, while star charts hang from pegs weighted with tiny polished stones.
Even in daylight, pinholes in the closed shutters sketch a constellation across the floor. A star wheel rests on the desk, set to a figure called the Lantern Bearer.

fixtures.name: Star Wheel
fixtures.examineDescription: Turning the paper disc brings the Lantern Bearer into view: five stars around a dim sixth. The chart says the faint star is easiest to find when you stop staring straight at it. A note adds: 'Useful advice for mysteries. Less useful for stairs.'
